description_json.name: Rot13WithSpaceToPlus
description_json.idea: Apply standard ROT13 to all alphabetic characters (preserving case). Replace all spaces with plus signs ('+') and all plus signs with spaces (' '). All other characters (digits, punctuation, symbols) remain unchanged. This is a highly reliable, simple, and easily reversible cipher that language models can process with minimal reasoning overhead.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary.
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary.
   c. If it is a space (' '), replace it with a plus sign ('+').
   d. If it is a plus sign ('+'), replace it with a space (' ').
   e. If it is any other character (digit, punctuation, symbol), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the ciphertext:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it back by 13 positions (which is equivalent to shifting forward by 13) in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary.
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it back by 13 positions (equivalent to shifting forward by 13) in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary.
   c. If it is a plus sign ('+'), replace it with a space (' ').
   d. If it is a space (' '), replace it with a plus sign ('+').
   e. If it is any other character (digit, punctuation, symbol), leave it unchanged.
